rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root, not a candidate: the classical D^2-law with a population rate of 0.55 mm2/s, replaced by the prefix's own finite-difference rate as the prefix grows; no extinction, no cool flame and no evaporation. Same numbers as the baseline of flex_heptane-wsp-v1, with the tensors added by flex_heptane-wsp-v2 set to their neutral values. Data-informed candidates of flex_heptane-wsp-v2 are literal revisions of this release.
